# EarthDaily

> EarthDaily provides AI-powered satellite earth observation data and geospatial analytics platforms for agriculture, insurance, mining, and infrastructure monitoring.

EarthDaily operates the EDC-01 satellite constellation and offers multiple specialized products including AiRD (AI-ready data), EarthOne (geospatial platform), and domain-specific solutions for crop intelligence, parametric insurance, mineral exploration, and river forecasting. The company serves agribusiness, agri-finance, commodity trading, and infrastructure sectors globally.

## Key Topics

- EarthDaily Constellation
- EDC-01 Satellite
- Change Detection

## Core Data Products

- [AiRD - AI-Ready Earth Observation Data](https://earthdaily.com/products/aird): AI-ready preprocessed Earth observation data for machine learning and change detection applications.
- [EarthMosaics - Cloud-Free Satellite Imagery Mosaics](https://earthdaily.com/earthmosaics): Seamless, cloud-free satellite imagery mosaics combining EDC and Sentinel-2/Landsat data.
- [Science - Top-of-Atmosphere Satellite Imagery](https://earthdaily.com/products/science): Top-of-atmosphere L1 calibrated imagery for advanced remote sensing and custom processing applications.
- [Maritime - Scalable Anomaly Detection for Oceans](https://earthdaily.com/products/maritime): Optimized satellite imagery for ocean anomaly detection and vessel monitoring.

## Geospatial Platforms

- [EarthOne - Geospatial AI/ML Platform](https://earthdaily.com/earthone): Scalable geospatial AI/ML platform for petabyte-scale data processing and production workflows.

## Agriculture & Crop Intelligence

- [Digital Ag - Field-Level Crop Intelligence](https://earthdaily.com/products/digital-ag): Field-level crop intelligence with near real-time monitoring, anomaly detection, and analytics.
- [Crop ID - AI-Driven Crop Classification](https://earthdaily.com/products/crop-id): AI-driven crop classification maps providing market intelligence 6-12 months ahead of government reports.
- [Territory Insights - Automated Crop Intelligence](https://earthdaily.com/products/ti): Automated crop intelligence and predictive analytics for agricultural retailers and agribusiness.
- [Agriculture Solutions - Optimize Agribusiness Decisions](https://earthdaily.com/ag): Comprehensive satellite data insights for crop monitoring, yield forecasting, and risk management.

## Insurance, Lending & Commodity Trading

- [Portfolio Management - Agricultural Insurance Solutions](https://earthdaily.com/products/portfolio-managment): Satellite intelligence for agricultural insurance underwriting, claims assessment, and portfolio optimization.
- [Parametric Insurance - Environmental Data for Index Design](https://earthdaily.com/products/parametric-insurance): High-quality environmental data for designing agricultural parametric insurance indices.
- [Insurance & Lending - Agri-Finance Solutions](https://earthdaily.com/insurance-lending): EO analytics for crop insurance and agricultural lending decisions.
- [Commodity Trading - Real-Time Crop Market Intelligence](https://earthdaily.com/commodity-trading): Real-time crop market intelligence and procurement optimization strategies.

## Mining & Infrastructure

- [Marigold - Mineral Exploration Platform](https://earthdaily.com/products/marigold): Cloud-accelerated mineral exploration platform with hyperspectral satellite data analytics.
- [Iris - Geotechnical Risk Detection](https://earthdaily.com/products/iris): InSAR-based satellite monitoring for geotechnical risk, subsidence, and infrastructure safety.
- [RiverSat - AI-Powered River Level Forecasting](https://earthdaily.com/products/riversat): AI-driven 28-day river level forecasts for logistics planning and low-water prediction.
